detail: Gate G5 (no-runtime-junk, .github/workflows/no-runtime-junk.yml) has 4 steps; only step 1 ("fail if runtime junk is tracked") was red. Root cause: commit af135d016 ("Commit IMP-0003 fixture plants ignored by root gitignore") force-added two files that root .gitignore already denies (.gitignore:1 node_modules/, :9 __pycache__/): command-center/p2-wave/probes/IMP-0003/work/probe1/fixture/lib/__pycache__/x.pyc and .../node_modules/leftpad/index.js. Verified no consumer needs them tracked: probe1_scanner_fixture.py:37-41 rmtree-rebuilds the whole fixture every run; probe2_census.py:98-101 rebuilds via build_fixture if the fixture is absent; UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json lists no work/ paths; no workflow file references IMP-0003; plugin tests do not touch this fixture. Fix: git rm --cached on exactly those two paths (worktree copies kept on disk, now gitignored so status stays clean). A stale 0-byte .git/index.lock (480s old, zero live git processes, corroborated by process table + mtime) was removed to unblock the index write. Red-proof held: pre-fix run flagged exactly the two [runtime-dir] paths (exit 1); post-fix scans 14,710 tracked files with 0 violations and 0 gitlinks (exit 0). The other 8 planted files under work/ (build.log, .DS_Store, blob.bin, README.md, sessions/agent.jsonl, fixture-git-plant/config, probe2 control/.gitkeep) are NOT violations of this gate's rule set and belong to a SUCCESS unit - deliberately left untouched. ORCHESTRATOR MUST COMMIT the staged deletions: CI reads committed state; until committed, a fresh clone still sees the junk in HEAD.
